dataSource: SELECT [TB Intakes].ID, [TB Intakes].[GI Last Name], [TB Intakes].[GI First Name], [TB Intakes].[GI phone], [TB Intakes].[GI Date], [TB Intakes].[GI Practice Area], [TB Intakes].[GI Individual Referrer], [TB Intakes].[GI Comments], [TB Intakes].[GI No Further Action], [TB Intakes].[GI Open], [TB Intakes].[GI Open Date], [TB Intakes].[GI Referral], [TB Intakes].ReasonDintHire, [TB Intakes].FollowUpDate, [TB Intakes].Attorny, [TB Intakes].QuotedFee FROM [TB Intakes] WHERE ((([TB Intakes].[GI Date]) Between getSTDT() And getENDT()));
